focus: security: licence obligations and the licence map
findingsSummary: 2 P2: the licence summary collapses Apache-2.0 obligations into "its notice" (R8-P2-001), and the claim that every row names its licence is false for 49 of 101 rows (R8-P2-002).

findingDetails.title: The licence summary collapses Apache-2.0's obligations into "its notice", erasing the distinction the plan draws
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inside the declared review target (research/research.md:26); cites the plan line the summary compresses. No file outside the target modified.
findingDetails.case: A builder lifts turnstone's show_controls under the research's rule, adds the NOTICE entry, and ships without the Apache-2.0 license text or the changed-files notice.
findingDetails.claim: The research gives MIT and Apache-2.0 the same single obligation ("its notice"), where the plan requires three for Apache-2.0.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether "notice" is a term of art covering the whole Apache-2.0 apparatus, and whether the plan governs instead of the research.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The sentence is a pointer to the plan, not the rule, and the plan states the full obligation correctly.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Stays P2 while the plan governs; becomes P1 if the research is used as the licence reference, because section 2 presents the licence map as the decision surface.

findingDetails.title: The licence paragraph says every row names the licence, and 49 of 101 numbered rows do not
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inside the declared review target (research/research.md:26); checked by counting every numbered row. No file outside the target modified.
findingDetails.case: A builder trusts that every row carries its licence and lifts the eight constants from 008 pitfall 1 without a notice entry, because that row names none.
findingDetails.claim: The claim "Every row names the licence and the line it was read from" is false for 49 of 101 numbered rows.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether "every row" means every lift-table row, where the claim does hold.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The sentence scopes to the lift tables, which all carry a Licence column.

results.check: The build's own licence is MIT, as section 1 states
Every reference repo's licence in the map is right
No row tells a builder to lift code from a GPL source
results.evidence: six "Lift" rows, none citing openhuman-full or tinychannels-main

results.check: Every section that cites a GPL source states the design-only rule
results.evidence: research/research.md:123 and the nine other section openings

results.check: The 011 lift table's five GPL rows carry the rule
Every row that lifts names the notice it needs
tinytools is GPL-3.0-only, as 007 differences row 1 states
The licence summary states the plan's Apache-2.0 obligations
Every numbered row names its licence, as the paragraph claims

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to the run and neither refines a prior finding: the licence summary and the every-row claim were not examined in iterations 1-7, which covered arithmetic, origin resolution, guard completeness, inference labelling, depth counts, ranking flags and diff output.
ruledOut: A licence error in the map
A row telling a builder to lift GPL code
A section citing GPL without stating the rule
